title: Unexpected Ally
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing looked at him, hesitating as if wanting to speak: "Chen Ji, Su Qingyao... is she really just an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow that simple?"

text.content: Ye Qing's voice was soft, yet it exploded like thunder beside Chen Ji's ear. The Holy Sect—that demonic giant that in rumors had slaughtered three thousand miles and cleansed six sect gates—was actually colluding with Tianqing Sect's old sect leader? Chen Ji's pupils contracted, his fingers unconsciously rubbing the torn page of ancient paper in his sleeve. The Tianji Record glowed faintly hot, as if warning him of the dangerous edge he was about to touch. "Continue." He lowered his voice, his tone平静得近乎冷酷. "How much do you know?" A complex light flickered in Ye Qing's beautiful eyes. This waste disciple who looked harmless was emanating an aura that made even her, a demonic path saint, feel a chill. She suddenly understood why the Holy Sect had listed this person as a key focus— this dormant chess piece was far more dangerous than he appeared.

dialogue.content: "The Holy Sect has numerous internal factions. Though I'm a saint, I'm merely a pawn of one side." Ye Qing's lips curved in self-mockery. "But precisely because of that, I can access things... I shouldn't know." She paused, weighing her words. "Ling Yuan's cooperation with the Holy Sect didn't start today. As early as thirty years ago, he was already an inside agent the Holy Sect placed in Tianqing Sect." Thirty years. Chen Ji calculated rapidly—at that time, Ling Yuan was merely an Inner Sect Elder, far from the sect leader's seat. Such a long timeline was enough to weave a massive web covering the entire sect. "What about Zhang Shen?" He named him directly. "What role does he play in this web?" Ye Qing's gaze slightly hardened, seemingly surprised by his keenness. "You really do know everything. Zhang Shen... is a subordinate Ling Yuan developed, and the Holy Sect's direct contact at Tianqing Sect. But what's interesting is—" Her voice suddenly dropped. "Zhang Shen seems to be hedging his bets lately. He's also in secret contact with Han Lie of Xuanwu Sect."

text.content: Intelligence sharing. Chen Ji nodded internally—this was what an alliance should offer. Every sentence Ye Qing spoke precisely struck puzzle pieces he hadn't yet connected, giving him a clearer understanding of the undercurrents within Tianqing Sect. But simultaneously, he was secretly evaluating—just what was this woman's true motive for revealing so much? Was it genuine cooperation or did she have ulterior designs? The Tianji Record sent no warnings, which slightly put him at ease. "What are your conditions?" Chen Ji stared directly into Ye Qing's eyes. "Your Holiness didn't travel far to infiltrate Tianqing Sect just to deliver intelligence to me." A wave finally appeared in Ye Qing's expression—deep beneath her cold mask lay hatred and grief. "My family... three hundred seventy-two people, slaughtered in a single night. And the one who carried out this massacre was a secret force within the Holy Sect itself." Her voice trembled slightly. "I spent ten years investigating, and finally discovered... the shadow of Tianqing Sect stands behind that force."

dialogue.content: "So you want revenge." Chen Ji's voice carried no inflection, yet somehow carried a resonance. Ye Qing raised her head, meeting his fathomless eyes directly. In that moment, she suddenly felt this person perhaps understood true hatred better than she did. "I need to know more." Chen Ji said slowly. "What's the purpose of Ling Yuan's cooperation with the Holy Sect? How much do they know about that 'Eye of Heavenly Secrets'?" Ye Qing's body trembled at his words. "You even know about the Eye of Heavenly Secrets?" Chen Ji gave no answer, simply taking from his sleeve that faintly glowing torn page, swaying it gently before Ye Qing. Ye Qing's eyes instantly widened, her pupils reflecting those mysterious patterns, her breath growing urgent. "This is... the Tianji Record?!"

text.content: "Tianji Record Fragment." Chen Ji returned the ancient paper to his sleeve. "I can see fragments of the future, but every glimpse requires payment." His tone was casual, as if discussing the weather. Ye Qing listened, her heart racing—the name Tianji Record thundered through demonic path classics. It was the legacy of ancient prophets, said to contain forbidden power capable of rewriting fate. Yet this servant disciple, dismissed as waste by the entire Tianqing Sect, actually possessed such a heaven-defying treasure? "No wonder..." Ye Qing murmured. "No wonder you could resolve crises every time, no wonder Ling Yuan fears you so much..." She suddenly laughed, the sound carrying a hint of relief. "Seems I've found the right person." Chen Ji looked at her. "So, have we reached consensus?" Ye Qing extended her hand. "Secret alliance, shared intelligence, jointly deal with Ling Yuan and the forces behind him. How about it?" Chen Ji didn't immediately shake hands but looked at her with a knowing half-smile. "Pleasure working with you. But I have one condition."

dialogue.content: "Your 'Demonic Path Mist.'" Chen Ji was direct. "Can it conceal the aura of the Tianji Record?" Ye Qing was startled, then understood his meaning. Such a heaven-defying treasure would inevitably emanate special fluctuations when used—detection by strong ones would be catastrophic. Her demonic path mist was precisely skilled at hiding auras; this truly was perfect complementarity. "Yes." She nodded. "But the range is limited, and each concealment consumes my spiritual power." Chen Ji finally extended his hand, lightly clasping hers. "That's enough." At the moment their palms touched, Ye Qing felt the chill of his fingers—that wasn't ordinary low body temperature, but a form of deficiency-cold from prolonged suppression of life force. She suddenly realized this man who seemed a waste might be supporting some terrifying scheme through a method nearly akin to self-destruction. "Chen Ji." She couldn't help but speak. "The price of the Tianji Record... how much have you paid?" Chen Ji released her hand, saying lightly: "More than you'd imagine. But this is my choice." His tone was平静得近乎残忍, as if discussing someone else's life and death. Ye Qing watched his departing back, an inexplicable emotion rising in her heart—admiration,心疼, or some kind of fellow-sufferer resonance, she herself couldn't tell.

text.content: Ye Qing gazed at his silhouette disappearing into the night, not moving for a long time. Moonlight fell on her beautiful face, reflecting a complex expression. "Interesting..." she murmured. "Seems this chess game is far more splendid than I imagined." She raised her hand, looking at the trace of chill remaining in her palm—that was the mark left from her handshake with Chen Ji. The demonic path saint's intuition told her this man harbored too many secrets, and the weight of those secrets might outweigh the entire Tianqing Sect. But strangely, she wasn't afraid. Instead, she felt an久违的兴奋—finally, an opponent and ally worth her full effort. The night wind brushed past, carrying a faint hint of blood scent. Ye Qing's gaze instantly sharpened—that was the警觉 unique to a demonic path saint. "Show yourself." Her voice恢复了惯常的冷漠. "Is tracking me very interesting?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji hadn't gone far—he was observing everything from the shadows. At this moment Ye Qing seemed to sense something. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.description: First see who the visitor is, determine friend or foe before deciding whether to act.
choices.risk_hint: If the visitor is hostile, Ye Qing may be in danger

text.content: Chen Ji收敛气息, fading into deeper shadows. His eyes faintly glowed under the moonlight—that was the Tianji Record Fragment passively activating—though unable to glimpse具体画面, it could vaguely perceive the visitor's approximate cultivation level. Foundation Building Late Stage, not exceeding Golden Core Early Stage. Not Ling Yuan's caliber, but not weak either.

choices.description: Ye Qing just formed an alliance with him; if he lets her face danger alone, it would seem too heartless.
choices.risk_hint: If there were埋伏, might fall into被动

text.content: Chen Ji's脚步一顿, without hesitation turning back. His silhouette stretched a long shadow in the moonlight, falling precisely before Ye Qing. "Seems our cooperation will be tested right from the start." His voice carried a hint of自嘲. Ye Qing turned to look at him, surprise flickering in her eyes, then transforming into an indescribable light. "Didn't you leave?" Chen Ji shrugged. "Halfway through, I remembered a question I hadn't asked." Of course he wouldn't say it was because he was worried about her safety—that would be too inconsistent with his废物人设.

choices.memory_label: 在夜清危险时挺身而出

text.content: The visitor walked slowly from the shadows—a young man wearing Tianqing Sect Inner Sect attire. His features were handsome, but a阴鸷气透出 between his brows, and at his waist hung a jade pendant carved with the character "Chen." Chen Ji's pupils contracted—someone from the Chen family. "Ye Qing Saint, visiting Tianqing Sect at such a late hour—what brings you here?" The young man's lips curved in amusement, though his gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment. "Oh? Chen Ji师弟 is also here? Rare indeed—a servant disciple like you dares wander the Rear Mountain." Chen Ji said nothing, merely stepping back half a pace, shielding Ye Qing behind him. His movement was natural, fitting the posture of a废物 seeking protection when encountering trouble. But if someone observed carefully, they'd notice his position恰好能在第一时间挡住任何可能的攻击路线.

dialogue.content: "Young master of the Chen family?" Ye Qing coldly smiled. "Your father sent you to track me?" The young man's expression slightly changed, clearly having been seen through. He was precisely Chen Yulou, the legitimate son of Chen family head Zhang Shen, rather well-known among Tianqing Sect Inner Disciples, though always overshadowed by Han Lie's brilliance. "Your Holiness jokes." Chen Yulou收起笑容, a flash of阴狠 appearing in his eyes. "I merely passed by by coincidence. But since we've encountered..." His gaze swept between Chen Ji and Ye Qing. "Why don't you tell me what you two are doing here?" Just as Ye Qing was about to speak, Chen Ji gently tugged her sleeve, signaling her not to冲动. Chen Ji's acting was精湛 at this moment—he微微躬身, displaying a诚惶诚恐的表情. "Chen师兄 misunderstands, this disciple merely... merely got lost. Hearing movement here, came to take a look. This disciple will leave now, not disturbing the senior and... this lady." He specifically加重了语气 on "lady," seemingly implying he didn't know Ye Qing's true identity at all.

text.content: Chen Yulou上下打量着 Chen Ji, the嘲讽 in his lips becoming more obvious. "With your废物样子, you dare wander the Rear Mountain? If you encounter demonic beasts, let's see how you die." His tone was full of轻蔑. "Fine, get lost. Don't obstruct the view here." Chen Ji nodded repeatedly,一副感激涕零的模样, turning to leave. Just then, Ye Qing suddenly spoke: "Wait." Chen Ji's heart tightened— what was this woman going to do?只见 Ye Qing stepped forward gracefully, staring eye-to-eye with Chen Yulou, an无形压迫感骤然扩散. Chen Yulou's face instantly turned pale, fine beads of sweat appearing on his forehead—that was the natural压制 from cultivation gap. "This young master," Ye Qing's voice was pleasant to the ear yet carried彻骨的寒意, "I don't care who sent you, but you'd better记住一件事." She微微俯身, whispering something near Chen Yulou's ear. Chen Ji couldn't hear what she said, but he saw Chen Yulou's face transition from pale to iron-blue, then from iron-blue to ashen, finally unable to resist trembling.

dialogue.content: "Get out now." Ye Qing straightened up, restoring her cold and noble demeanor. Chen Yulou shot Chen Ji a fierce glare, as if wanting to say something, but ultimately clenched his teeth and turned to leave. Only after his figure completely vanished into the night did Ye Qing slowly exhale, turning to look at Chen Ji. "Sorry for letting you see that." Her tone returned to calm. "Those were some... internal methods from our Holy Sect. Effective for intimidating people, but they don't last long." Chen Ji shook his head, a hint of amusement flickering in his eyes: "What did you tell him?" Ye Qing hesitated, then told the truth: "I told him I had witnessed his father Chen Shen meeting secretly with Holy Sect envoys. If he didn't want this matter brought before the sect elders, he'd better keep his mouth shut." Chen Ji raised an eyebrow: "Is that true?" Ye Qing nodded: "Absolutely. I saw it with my own eyes." She paused, then added, "That's also one of the reasons I came to find you—I need more evidence, and people inside Tianqing Sect... are clearly more likely to have access to those secrets than I am."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing demonstrated her sincerity and value. Chen Ji must respond—whether to reveal more intelligence about Chen Shen to her?

choices.description: Since this is an alliance, showing some sincerity is necessary, but one shouldn't reveal everything.
choices.visible_cost: May expose one's own trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may have other motives

text.content: "Chen Shen is preparing something big." Chen Ji沉思片刻, deciding to reveal part of the intelligence: "At the sect competition three months from now, he'll arrange for someone to 'accidentally' seriously injure several core disciples during the match, then frame Xuanwu Sect. Once Tianqing Sect and Xuanwu Sect clash, he'll have an opportunity to fish in troubled waters." Upon hearing this, Ye Qing's eyes gleamed: "What a vicious scheme. No wonder the Holy Sect chose him as their pawn." Chen Ji nodded: "But this is only the surface. What I care more about is—what's his real purpose behind all this?" Ye Qing fell into deep thought: "You're right. A Golden Core stage Inner Sect Elder, even if he betrays the sect, can't make that big a wave. Unless... he's just a piece in a larger game." Their gazes met in mid-air, both seemingly thinking of the same terrifying possibility.

choices.memory_label: 与夜清共同分析陈深的目的

choices.description: Intelligence is leverage—it cannot be shown easily. First, test how many trump cards Ye Qing still has.
choices.visible_cost: May make Ye Qing feel the cooperation lacks sincerity

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer immediately. Instead, he asked: "Before I say more, I want to know—how much do you know about Ling Yuan?" Ye Qing slightly frowned, clearly dissatisfied with his caution, but she still answered: "Ling Yuan is a piece placed by the Holy Sect thirty years ago, but his relationship with the Holy Sect isn't one of subordination—it's more like... cooperation." Chen Ji became interested: "Cooperation? At what level?" Ye Qing's expression grew grave: "As far as I know, Ling Yuan is searching for something. And the Holy Sect happens to know where that thing is. They each take what they need, which is why they've been cooperating for so many years." Chen Ji contemplated: "So Ling Yuan's real purpose isn't to betray Tianqing Sect, but to find something... interesting." He suddenly remembered something Mo Xiansheng once said—"The inheritor of the Tianji Record is never by coincidence." Could Ling Yuan also be searching for secrets related to the Tianji Record?

choices.memory_label: 试探出凌渊的真实目的线索

text.content: "You suspect what Ling Yuan is searching for?" Ye Qing keenly caught his change of expression. Chen Ji沉思片刻, deciding to take a small risk: "The complete version of the Tianji Record." Ye Qing's eyes widened: "What?" Chen Ji spread open his palm, and that page of ancient paper appeared once more under the moonlight. The ink-like patterns faintly glimmered, emanating an ancient aura that made one's heart race. "The Tianji Record originally had nine pages, containing all the methods by which ancient seers peered into heavenly secrets. What exists in the world today... as far as I know, only this one page remains." He paused: "But the Tianji Record itself seems to be searching for its other fragments, and every holder of a fragment... becomes some kind of 'target.'" Ye Qing's breathing quickened: "Are you saying Ling Yuan might hold other fragments? Or... he himself is one of the targets chosen by the Tianji Record?" Chen Ji shook his head: "I'm not sure. But one thing is certain—Ling Yuan's布局 over Tianqing Sect is definitely not merely for power. He must be pursuing something much deeper." The two stared at each other in silence. In the night wind, only the whistling wind remained, bringing waves of chill.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." Ye Qing suddenly spoke, her tone becoming exceptionally serious: "Do you know? I once thought I was the biggest loser in this chess game. Three hundred seventy-two lives, ten years of blood feud—I thought only revenge could free me." She laughed lightly, her smile carrying traces of bitterness: "But now I discover, you're worse off than me." Chen Ji raised an eyebrow: "Oh?" Ye Qing直视 his eyes: "Your fate was bound to the Tianji Record from the start. Every glimpse of the future comes with a price, every step closer to truth faces backlash. You don't even know how long you can live." Her voice trembled slightly: "Yet you persist, advancing carefully in this chess game. You... what exactly are you fighting for?" Chen Ji fell silent. The night wind lifted his robes, revealing the faintly glowing fragment in his sleeve. He lifted his head, gazing at the deep night sky, and only after a long moment spoke: "To control my own fate." His voice was soft, yet carried undeniable resolve: "The Tianji Record says I'm a chess piece, so I'll prove to heaven—chess pieces can also devour the chess player." Ye Qing stared at him blankly. At this moment, she suddenly felt that the back of this man before her was taller than any strong person she had ever seen.

choice.prompt: Ye Qing was moved by Chen Ji's spirit. She proposed wanting to understand the secrets of the Tianji Record more deeply. As Chen Ji, should you let her access the core of the Tianji Record?

choices.description: Since this is an alliance, one should give sufficient trust. Besides, she still has utility.
choices.visible_cost: May expose more secrets of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record may have protective mechanisms

dialogue.content: "You want to see?" Chen Ji looked at Ye Qing's longing eyes and made an unexpected decision. He handed the Tianji Record fragment before Ye Qing: "Go ahead, try." Ye Qing reached out her hand. The moment her fingertips touched the yellowed paper surface, a chill immediately spread up her arm. The next second, countless blurry images flashed before her eyes—blades and swords, mountains of corpses drenched in blood, a pair of eyes hidden in mist... "Ah!" Ye Qing abruptly pulled back her hand, her face pale as paper: "What... was that?" Chen Ji收回 the fragment, his expression unchanged: "A glimpse from the Tianji Record. It varies by person. You saw more than I expected." Ye Qing gasped heavily, yet excitement flickered in her eyes: "I saw... a pair of eyes. Those eyes were watching me, like... like Heaven's Way itself." Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Eyes of Heaven's Way? She actually saw that thing too?

choices.memory_label: 夜清与天机录产生共鸣

choices.description: The secrets of the Tianji Record are too significant. Letting her access it now is too early.
choices.visible_cost: might make Ye Qing feel distrusted
choices.visible_reward: keep the core trump card hidden

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the fragment back into his sleeve, his movements natural yet carrying an undeniable firmness: "I'm sorry, not yet." Ye Qing's expression faltered momentarily, but quickly regained its composure. She could understand - with a heaven-defying treasure like the Tianji Record, she wouldn't show it to others lightly either. "It's fine." She shook her head gently, "I've already seen enough just now." Chen Ji was surprised: "What did you see?" Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, as if organizing her words: "I saw... my own ending. And also..." Her gaze deepened, "a blurry figure. That figure stood in a sea of blood, yet was still smiling." Chen Ji's heart stirred - a smile in the sea of blood? Could the future she saw involve him? The two fell into silence once more, but this time, the air between them carried an invisible bond. As fellow players in this chess game, they seemed to recognize something familiar in each other - a resilience that refused to yield even when trampled by fate.

choices.memory_label: 夜清分享了她看到的模糊预言

text.content: "It's getting late." Ye Qing broke the silence first, "Staying any longer will raise suspicion." She took out a black Jade Pendant from her sleeve and handed it to Chen Ji: "This is my communication token. Crush it, and I can sense your location. No matter where you are in the Tianqing Sect, if you crush it, I'll arrive within three days." Chen Ji took the Jade Pendant, its surface cool to the touch, carved with a spreading Dark Crow - the symbol of the Holy Sect. "What about you?" he asked, "What if I need to find you?" Ye Qing smiled lightly, pointing to her brow center: "I'm the Holy Maiden. Within the Holy Sect's intelligence network, I have countless ways to pass messages. You only need to do one thing - find a way to send news to the innkeeper at the Drunken Immortal Tavern in the city. He'll pass it to me." Chen Ji nodded and carefully stored the Jade Pendant. The two stood facing each other, moonlight casting a faint shadow between them. These were two people who should have been sworn enemies - one a废物 disciple of a righteous sect, the other a breathtakingly beautiful maiden from the Holy Land of the Demonic Path. But now, bound by common enemies and personal blood feuds, they stood on the same front. "Chen Ji." Ye Qing gave him one final glance, "Take care. When this is all over... let's share a good drink." With that, her figure turned into a wisp of black mist and slowly dissolved into the night.

Chen Ji stood alone, gazing toward where Ye Qing had vanished. After a long while, he took out the black Jade Pendant from his sleeve and examined it closely in his palm. The Dark Crow pattern was faint in the moonlight, carrying a hint of demonic energy. He suddenly let out a soft laugh: "The Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path... interesting." That night, he had gained too much information. Ling Yuan's cooperation with the Holy Sect, Chen Shen's conspiracy, and that mysterious 'Eye of Heavenly Dao'... all these fragments were gradually assembling into a terrifying picture in his mind. The waters of the Tianqing Sect ran far deeper than he had imagined. But that was fine. The deeper the water, the greater the waves he could stir. Chen Ji put away the Jade Pendant and turned toward the Servants' Quarters. The night wind blew, lifting the corner of his robe. Under the moonlight, his silhouette was solitary and composed, like a lone wolf about to enter the game. "Ling Yuan..." he silently recited that name in his heart, "Chen Shen... and the so-called Eye of Heavenly Dao..." A meaningful smile curved his lips, "This chess game has just begun."

When he returned to the Servants' Quarters, the eastern sky was already turning bright. Chen Ji lay on that hard wooden bed, placing the black Jade Pendant on his chest, feeling its coolness seep through. An unexpected ally - that was his definition of this night. Ye Qing's appearance had disrupted his original layout rhythm. But from another perspective, this could also be an opportunity. The Demonic Path's mist could conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, meaning he would be safer when using it. And Ye Qing's knowledge of the Holy Sect could save him considerable time spent exploring. More importantly - she was also someone who refused to yield even when trampled by fate. This point mattered more than any intelligence. Chen Ji closed his eyes, and Ye Qing's gaze before she departed surfaced in his mind. That gaze held expectation, trust, and something else... something he couldn't see through. "Take care, when this is all over... let's share a good drink." He murmured, repeating these words, and suddenly felt a tightness in his chest. Perhaps it was the price of the Tianji Record, perhaps something else. He took a deep breath, dispelling those wandering thoughts. Now was not the time for sentiment. Starting tomorrow, he had even more important matters to attend to.

Dawn broke, and Chen Ji appeared promptly at the Spiritual Fields behind the Servants' Quarters. He was the most diligent Servant Disciple in the entire Tianqing Sect, rising before dawn every day to work, not returning until long after dark. This routine had continued for three years, and in those three years, no one noticed his abnormalities, nor did anyone care what he was thinking. A废物 should have the appearance of a废物. He silently recited this phrase, yet his hands never stopped moving. Loosening soil, fertilizing, pest control... every step was done meticulously, as if he were truly just a low-ranking disciple contributing his meager strength to the sect. But just as he bent down to pull weeds, the corner of his eye caught a figure approaching from the distance. The figure wore an elegant white dress, hair cascading like a waterfall, her face cold and composed - it was Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. Chen Ji's heart tightened slightly. This first beauty of the Tianqing Sect was one of the figures he guarded against most. She had approached him repeatedly, each time with veiled attempts at probing, as if searching for some weakness. "Chen Ji, younger brother." Su Qingyao's voice was cold as frost, "Good morning." Chen Ji hastily bowed: "Good morning, Senior Sister Su." He kept his head lowered, appearing respectful and deferential, but failed to see the sharp glint that flickered in her eyes.

Su Qingyao did not leave immediately but stood by the Spiritual Fields, quietly watching Chen Ji work. The morning light fell upon her exquisite face, yet could not penetrate those deep eyes of hers. Her gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a long time, as if searching for some trace of evidence. Chen Ji felt the weight of that gaze, but he did not look up, continuing to focus on pulling weeds with his head lowered. His movements were slow and careful, like an honest man who didn't know how to be lazy. "Chen Ji, younger brother." Su Qingyao suddenly spoke, "There was activity at the Rear Mountain last night. Do you know about it?" Chen Ji's hand paused microscopically, then returned to normal. He raised his head, revealing a simple, honest smile: "Reporting to Senior Sister, the disciple rested in the Servants' Quarters all night and didn't hear any unusual sounds." Su Qingyao stared into his eyes, her gaze sharp as a blade: "Is that so? Someone detected the aura of a Demonic Path cultivator at the Rear Mountain. The sect's higher-ups are taking this seriously and have sent people to investigate." Chen Ji wore a look of confusion: "Demonic Path cultivators? At our Tianqing Sect? This... this is terrifying! Senior Sister, please be careful!" His expression perfectly displayed the fear and worry a废物 disciple should have, showing no flaws whatsoever. Su Qingyao's eyes flickered slightly, as if deep in thought. After a long while, she sighed softly: "The younger brother is right. I'll be careful." She turned and left, her white dress floating gently in the morning breeze, leaving behind a faint fragrance. Chen Ji watched her departing figure, and a cold light glinted in the depths of his eyes. Su Qingyao... just how much does she know?
